sources.fullCitation: Bibliothèque nationale de France, notice de personne “Rey, Georges (1908-2011)”, forme internationale, FRBNF16974300. Born 27 May 1908 in Papeete, Tahiti; died 6 January 2011 in Bazas, Gironde. Described as a Tahitian composer, singer and musician who worked as an assistant book-keeper in an American camp in the Gironde, and known also under the pseudonym Tihoti-Ré, or Tihoti-Re. The notice cites as its sources the Pathé disc of “O chant d'amour de Tahiti !” and Claude Lestrade, “Quelques souvenirs de Tahiti de 1942 à 1945 (2e partie),” Journal de la Société des océanistes 95 (1992), pp. 251–274. Accessed 1 August 2026.
